title: Leverage Points
hook: One pricing change can outwork six months of grinding.
statement: Small moves in the right spot change everything.
explainer: Price, offer, positioning ripple everywhere. Grinding in low-leverage spots barely moves anything.
sop: List your levers: price, offer, positioning.
Score Change and Leverage Multiplier 1 to 10.
Pull the top one. Ignore the rest.
equation_example: Change 4 × Leverage Multiplier 8 = 32. One pricing tweak hitting revenue, margin, and positioning.
question: Name the lever you ignore because it looks too simple.
closing_statement: Find the lever. Then pull hard.
